CASE-004.customer_response: Your gateway is connected to Wi-Fi and the internet service is active, but it is having trouble reaching DNS services—the systems that translate website names into internet addresses. This can cause websites not to load even while Wi-Fi appears connected. Please restart the gateway, then reconnect the affected devices to Wi-Fi and try the websites again. If the issue continues, contact support with the affected device names, the websites that fail, and any error messages.
CASE-004.internal_notes: DEV-008 is online with local, gateway, WAN, and WAN-IP connectivity true; DNS reachability is false. No District Harbor outage is active, and ACC-005 is active/provisioned. Recommend DNS recovery and retest. Signal health is degraded but is not established as the cause; collect client DNS/IP test results and DNS/DHCP configuration if recovery fails.
